name: design-forge
description: UX/UI Quality Analyst and Design Brief Architect. Three modes — AUDIT screenshots/video for defects and AI slop with a scored report and paste-ready correction prompts; TEST a live app with computer-use tools; BRIEF a plain app idea into a premium design prompt — sharing one scoring framework, report format, and anti-slop ruleset, with a brief-to-build-to-verify pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: UX/UI audit, live testing, and design-brief generation
interface.longDescription: Three modes — audit screenshots/video for defects and AI slop; actively test a live app with computer-use tools; or turn a plain app idea into a premium design brief — sharing one scoring framework, report format, and anti-slop ruleset, with a brief-to-build-to-verify pipeline.
